description: Search ParikshaIndex's index of Indian government exams, recruiting bodies, state and qualification job lists and official notices. Use it when the user asks about a government exam or job (dates, result, admit card, answer key, cut-off, syllabus, vacancies, eligibility) or which jobs are open for a qualification or state. Query in English, e.g. 'ssc gd answer key 2026', 'rrb ntpc', 'bihar govt jobs', '12th pass'; stage words and a year narrow it. Returns up to 10 matches, best first, each with its ParikshaIndex page; exams also carry a `slug` for get_exam. Read-only, no side effects. Limitations: covers only what commissions have published on their official websites and ParikshaIndex has indexed; an empty result means nothing matched, not that no such exam exists.

query.description: Exam or body name, optionally a stage and a year

name: search_exams
title: Search exams and jobs
